product_metadata.title: Laptop Buddy Portable Lap Desk- Cushioned Bottom with Foam Beads, Pen Tray and Cup Holder- Tray for Computers, Writing, Reading & Food by Lavish Home
features: WORK ANYWHERE - Whether you are reading, writing, working on a laptop or tablet, this lap desk will keep you out of an uncomfortable desk and in the comforts of your own home. Use it poolside, on the couch or at the counter-the possibilities are endless.

PORTABLE - The built-in carry handle and the lightweight design make the “Laptop Buddy” the perfect travel companion for you and your laptop for trips in a car, airplane or train- you will never want to leave home without it!

QUALITY COMFORT - The durable, water resistant top gives you the feel of a real desktop, and the cozy, fleece covered foam bead base provides added comfort and the luxury of being able to move where you’d like!

CONVENIENT FEATURES - Equipped with a cup holder that will hold most cup sizes safely and a recessed pen holder that won’t interfere with your typing, this lap desk is a must-have addition to any reading or workspace.
PRODUCT DETAILS - Material: Plastic, Foam Beads and Fleece. Dimensions: (L) 15.75” x (W) 13” x (H) 2”. Cup Holder Dimensions: 3” Diameter x 1” Deep. Color: Gray.
description: The Laptop Buddy Portable Lap Desk by Lavish Home will keep you in the comfort of your bed, favorite chair, car or sofa and out of an uncomfortable desk! The durable, water resistant top gives you the feel of a real desktop, and the cozy, fleece base provides added comfort and the luxury of being able to move where you’d like! Equipped with a cup holder that will hold most cup sizes safely and a recessed pen holder that won’t interfere with your typing, this lap desk is a must-have addition to any reading or workspace.
